description: Use whenever source code, schemas, types, enums, or configuration are about to become ontology classes, properties, or taxonomy — any extraction-to-T-Box step. Use when the user asks whether something is a kind, role, phase, relator, event, or "just an implementation artifact"; when auditing a taxonomy or class hierarchy for category mistakes; when deciding if two concepts are related at all; or whenever the words denotation, identity criterion, rigidity, OntoClean, UFO, foundational audit, or ontological commitment come up. Runs between ontology-scout and ontology-conceptualizer as the gate that keeps representations from silently becoming referents.
